# YuGiMob

> Extensions for the pi coding agent: anchored edits, keyless web tools, Tor routing, guarded commits, and a benchmark that publishes the traces.

I'm YuGiMob. I build extensions for pi, the terminal coding agent, and publish them on npm. This page is where they live, each with a demo you can run.

The pattern behind all of them is the same. An agent changes a file that looks right and is subtly wrong, or runs a command a human would have paused on. Most fixes are better prompts and good intentions. I would rather move the failure into the tool, where it can be refused, caught, or made impossible.

If you run coding agents against real repositories, you have watched at least one of these failures happen. Each tool below starts with the problem it exists to kill; the benchmark at the end is how I check my own work, including the runs I lose.

## Tools

- [pi-hashline-edit-pro](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-hashline-edit-pro): Every served line gets its own four-letter anchor. Install: `pi install npm:pi-hashline-edit-pro`. Stars 88, 4,285 npm installs per week.
- [pi-unsloth-webtools](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-unsloth-webtools): One tool for search, one for fetch, one for pages that need JavaScript. Install: `pi install npm:pi-unsloth-webtools`. Stars 2, 801 npm installs per week.
- [pi-tor-proxy](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-tor-proxy): The extension downloads its own Tor binary, verifies it against a SHA-256 hash, and routes every request through it. Install: `pi install npm:pi-tor-proxy`. Stars 3, 39 npm installs per week.
- [pi-msg-workflow](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-msg-workflow): Numbered message and command stores keep the plan outside the conversation, where you can edit it. Install: `pi install npm:pi-msg-workflow`. Stars 1, 110 npm installs per week.
- [pi-git-commit](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-git-commit): The bash guard blocks mutative git commands before they run. Install: `pi install npm:pi-git-commit`. Stars 1, 168 npm installs per week.

## Evidence

- [pi-edit-benchmark](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark): pi-edit-benchmark drives real models through each tool's own tools and scores correctness, safety, and robustness. 11 contenders over 9 models × 35 scenarios, 315 runs each (3,465 total).
- [hashline-edit-pro](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/pi-hashline-edit-pro-b9-boundary-changed.json) v4.3.5: 97.8% overall, 98.9% staleness, 92.1% served state across 315 runs
- [hashline-edit-pro-diff0](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/pi-hashline-edit-pro-diff0-b10-duplicate-drift.json) v4.3.5: 97.8% overall, 98.9% staleness, 93.7% served state across 315 runs; -1.9 to +1.9 points, Holm-adjusted p=1.000 against the highlighted tool
- [doompi-edit](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/_agimon-ai_doompi-edit-b9-boundary-changed.json) v0.0.1-alpha.49: 94.3% overall, 95.6% staleness, 98.4% served state across 315 runs; -6.9 to -0.3 points, Holm-adjusted p=0.087 against the highlighted tool
- [hashline-readmap](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/pi-hashline-readmap-b9-boundary-changed.json) v0.14.0: 93.0% overall, 94.4% staleness, 90.5% served state across 315 runs; -8.1 to -1.9 points, Holm-adjusted p=0.008 against the highlighted tool
- [hashline-context-edit](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/pi-hashline-context-edit-b9-boundary-changed.json) v0.11.0: 90.2% overall, 96.7% staleness, 100.0% served state across 315 runs; -11.6 to -3.9 points, Holm-adjusted p=< 0.001 against the highlighted tool
- [hashline-edit](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/pi-hashline-edit-b9-boundary-changed.json) v0.8.3: 89.8% overall, 96.7% staleness, 100.0% served state across 315 runs; -12.0 to -4.2 points, Holm-adjusted p=< 0.001 against the highlighted tool
- [aft-pi](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/_cortexkit_aft-pi-b9-boundary-changed.json) v0.56.2: 88.3% overall, 84.4% staleness, 98.4% served state across 315 runs; -13.8 to -5.6 points, Holm-adjusted p=< 0.001 against the highlighted tool
- [pix-edit](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/_xynogen_pix-edit-b10-duplicate-drift.json) v0.2.5: 88.3% overall, 84.4% staleness, 95.2% served state across 315 runs; -13.7 to -5.7 points, Holm-adjusted p=< 0.001 against the highlighted tool
- [agent-ide](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/pi-agent-ide-b9-boundary-changed.json) v0.6.2: 83.5% overall, 85.6% staleness, 98.4% served state across 315 runs; -18.9 to -10.0 points, Holm-adjusted p=< 0.001 against the highlighted tool
- [built-in edit](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/builtin-edit-b10-duplicate-drift.json) v0.85.1: 79.4% overall, 73.3% staleness, 95.2% served state across 315 runs; -23.4 to -13.7 points, Holm-adjusted p=< 0.001 against the highlighted tool
- [semantic-edit](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/traces/deepseek-v4.1-flash/pi-semantic-edit-b9-boundary-changed.json) v0.4.0: 77.1% overall, 65.6% staleness, 93.7% served state across 315 runs; -25.7 to -15.7 points, Holm-adjusted p=< 0.001 against the highlighted tool
- [Run report](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/blob/main/results/llm-report.json): the committed JSON every figure comes from
- [Committed traces](https://github.com/YuGiMob/pi-edit-benchmark/tree/main/results/traces): one trace per scored run

## Data

- [Markdown mirror](https://yugimob.github.io/index.md): the whole page as markdown, generated from the two data files
- [Interactive demo](https://yugimob.github.io/?step=1): the anchored-edit guide, one step per URL
- [Machine data](https://yugimob.github.io/data/site-data.json): stars, downloads, activity, history, and benchmark numbers, refreshed daily
- [Curated showcase](https://yugimob.github.io/data/showcase.json): the narrative behind every tool, one entry per problem
- [Scenario matrix](https://yugimob.github.io/data/benchmark-matrix.json): pass counts per scenario and contender behind the benchmark chart
- [Agent readability](https://yugimob.github.io/agent-readability.json): the machine-readable entry points this site publishes
- [Feed](https://yugimob.github.io/feed.json): a JSON Feed of the daily benchmark and install snapshots
- [Sitemap](https://yugimob.github.io/sitemap.xml): the single canonical page
